policies.title: Solomon Islands: EU ordinary passports visa-free for short stays
policies.summary: The Immigration Division says the EU–Solomon Islands waiver applies to ordinary passports for visa-free short stays, excluding Ireland.
conditions: The source expressly covers ordinary passports, short stays for tourism, cultural visits, scientific activities or business, and excludes paid employment.
The page states a maximum 90 days in any 180-day period and excludes Ireland; it does not establish a route for other European nationalities or special travel documents.

The page also presents online-application and grant-letter text alongside its direct visa-free statement. This policy relies only on the express short-stay waiver and assigns no application, port, fee, entry-count or other operational condition.

policies.title: Solomon Islands: PRC ordinary passports visa-free for short stays
policies.summary: The Immigration Division states that the PRC mutual exemption permits ordinary-passport holders to travel to Solomon Islands without a visa.
conditions: The direct mutual-exemption statement covers ordinary PRC passports and says visa-free entry is up to 30 days per visit for tourism, business, family or transit purposes.

The same operational page also contains online-application, grant-letter and differing accumulated-stay text. No duration, eVisa route, fee, entry count or port is normalized beyond the expressly stated visa-free ordinary-passport status.
Work remains outside this short-visitor policy.

policies.title: Solomon Islands: UAE ordinary passports visa-free for short stays
policies.summary: The Immigration Division states that the UAE reciprocal agreement covers ordinary passports and permits visa-free entry.
conditions: The source expressly says the reciprocal agreement covers all passport classifications, including ordinary passports, for up to 90 days.

The same operational page contains online-application and grant-letter text. This policy relies only on the direct visa-free agreement statement and does not normalize an eVisa, entry count, fee or port.

policies.title: Solomon Islands: concessional ordinary passports receive a visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current legal notice designates this nationality cohort for concessional entry, and government guidance says the cohort need not apply in advance and receives a visitor visa on arrival.
conditions: Legal Notice No. 128 names this exact concessional-country cohort and repeals earlier concessional notices. The government guidance says they do not apply in advance and are granted a visitor visa on arrival.
Arrival requires a passport valid for at least six months and a confirmed return or onward ticket; immigration retains ordinary entry and admission discretion.

This is visa_on_arrival, not visa-free admission. The current Immigration tourist page calls arrival issuance discretionary and gives inconsistent general tourist durations, so no uniform stay, extension, entry count, fee or port is assigned.

China and the covered EU ordinary passports are excluded because current, more specific mutual-exemption sources directly establish visa-free treatment; UAE is separately supported by its specific agreement.
